description: Resolve whether a real-world event happened, or who won it, from Wikipedia text. Every yes/no answer carries a sentence quoted word for word from the cited article, checked in code. An event whose period has not ended, or that the sources do not settle, is answered "unresolved" instead of guessed. Same resolver as the Takar Outcome miner on Telegraph.

event.description: The event as a question, with its year, e.g. "Did Argentina win the 2022 FIFA World Cup?". At most 500 characters.

name: resolve_event
